items.title: Q2 Earnings Roundup: ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) And The Rest Of The Automation Software Segment
items.summary: Quarterly earnings results are a good time to check in on a company’s progress, especially compared to its peers in the same sector. Today we are looking at ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) and the best and worst performers in the automation software industry.

items.title: ServiceNow, IBD Stock Of The Day, Clears Early Buy Point As 'SaaSpocalypse' Fears Fade
items.summary: ServiceNow stock nears a buy point as easing AI disruption fears and AI product sales fuel a sharp rebound from early 2026 plunge.

items.title: Agentic AI Adoption Boosts NOW's Growth Prospects Against MSFT & CRM
items.summary: ServiceNow's Agentic AI momentum drives $1B-plus AI ACV, broader enterprise adoption and new monetization opportunities despite rising competition.

items.title: Software Stocks Are Surging Back—And Salesforce Just Showed Why
items.summary: The benchmark software ETF now above water for the year after Salesforce’s solid earnings. Salesforce is turning itself into a force because of its partnership with Anthropic.

items.title: Accenture to Acquire Tokyo's COMWARE: Is it a Growth Catalyst?
items.summary: ACN's COMWARE deal adds more than 180 professionals and SAP, CRM and manufacturing expertise to expand AI-led services for Japan's mid-market.

items.title: Veeva Systems Stock Is Having Its Best Day Ever as Software Sector Rallies
items.summary: Veeva Systems stock surges and is having its best day ever after the software company’s quarterly earnings and guidance made Wall Street believers.

items.title: Salesforce Soars 14% as Claudeforce and a Guidance Raise End the Slump, ServiceNow Climbs 5%, Adobe Advances 3%
items.summary: Salesforce spent months as the broken name in enterprise software, dragging the sector's AI credibility down with it. Now one earnings report and a surprise Anthropic partnership are forcing the bears to rethink everything.

items.title: ServiceNow (NOW) In Focus Following Tech Mahindra AI Deal As Fair Value Debate Builds
items.summary: ServiceNow (NOW) is back in focus after Tech Mahindra expanded a multi year partnership aimed at scaling AI deployments on the ServiceNow platform, while a separate employee stock offering adds another wrinkle for investors to assess. For context, ServiceNow shares trade at US$127.00 after a strong 30 day share price return of 28.57% and a 90 day share price return of 24.36%.
